why_this_exists: Discovered while constructing identity evidence for the step-2 corporate-action check's batch-1 spec: HURN's own earnings 8-K (2025-07-31) showed clean items (2.02, 9.01), but a wholly separate 8-K (items 1.01, 2.03, 9.01 -- a $1.1B credit-facility refinancing, WITH its own 'FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE' press release) was filed under a different accession number just 18 minutes later. The original batch-1/batch-2 chronology review (reports/m2-step2-chronology-batch-*-2026-09-28.json) only read each candidate's own accession number's item codes, so it could not have caught a genuinely separate same-day filing. This report closes that gap for all 46 surviving candidates, not just HURN.
method: For each of the 46 surviving candidates, fetched the issuer's SEC submissions.json (data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK<cik>.json) and listed every 8-K filed within roughly two weeks of the candidate's own filing date, then checked for any OTHER accession number filed on the exact same calendar date. A same-day hit was read in full and assessed against docs/SAME-DAY-COMPETING-CATALYST-POLICY.md's three-part test.
